## API

Everything below is imported from `@nanahoshi/mona-ui/chart`.

### `ChartComponent`

Root visualization container coordinating coordinate layouts, canvas rendering, theme styles, and interactions.

**Selector:** `mona-chart`

#### Inputs

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `animation` | `ChartAnimationInput` | `true` | Animation settings for initial render and subsequent data or visibility transitions. |
| `aria-description` | `string` | `""` | Detailed accessible description explaining the chart's purpose and trends. |
| `aria-label` | `string` | `""` | Accessible name for the chart container. |
| `class` | `string` | `""` | Additional CSS classes applied to chart root container. |
| `data` | `readonly unknown[]` | `[]` | Primary dataset shared across all child series. |
| `dataTable` | `boolean` | `false` | Renders a visually hidden table of the chart's data (its first 100 rows) for screen readers. |
| `defaultViewport` | `ChartViewportState \| undefined` | `undefined` | Initial default viewport window state for chart axes. |
| `downsampling` | `ChartDownsamplingInput` | `true` | High-density downsampling policy for eligible dense series. |
| `landmark` | `boolean` | `false` | Makes the chart a `region` landmark instead of an `application`. A landmark keeps screen readers in browse mode, so they read the arrow keys themselves; give each landmark chart a unique name. |
| `navigation` | `ChartNavigationInput` | `false` | Navigation, panning, and zooming options for the chart. |
| `renderer` | `ChartRendererMode` | `"canvas"` | The rendering engine used to draw the chart surface ("canvas" \| "svg"). |
| `subtitle` | `string` | `""` | Subtitle text rendered beneath the title. |
| `synchronization` | `ChartSynchronizationInput` | `false` | Cross-chart synchronization configuration. Accepts `false`, a group name shorthand, or full options. |
| `title` | `string` | `""` | Title text rendered above the plot area. |
| `titleAlign` | `ChartHeaderAlignment` | `"start"` | Horizontal alignment of the title and subtitle ('center', 'left', or 'right'). |
| `viewport` | `ChartViewportState \| undefined` | `undefined` | Active viewport window state for chart axes. Bind `[(viewport)]` for two-way binding. While it is defined the parent owns the viewport: a change applies once the parent writes it back. |
| `xField` | `ChartField` | `""` | Property key or accessor extracting the X-axis coordinate for each data item. |

#### Outputs

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pointClick` | `ChartPointEvent<unknown>` | Emits when a data point, vertex, or bar in the chart is clicked. |
| `pointFocusChange` | `ChartPointFocusEvent<unknown>` | Emits when the keyboard focus moves to a new data point, spoke, or series. |
| `seriesVisibilityChange` | `ChartSeriesVisibilityEvent` | Emits when a series visibility state is toggled via legend interaction. |
| `viewportChange` | `ChartViewportState` | Emits the new viewport state when it changes via pan, zoom, fit, reset, or keyboard navigation. |
| `viewportChangeDetails` | `ChartViewportChangeEvent` | Emits with each viewport change, along with the previous state, source, gesture phase and changed axes. |

#### Methods

| Signature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `downloadChart(options: ChartDownloadOptions): Promise<ChartExportResult>` | Exports and triggers a browser file download of the chart in PNG, SVG, or PDF format. |
| `exportChart(options: ChartExportOptions): Promise<ChartExportResult>` | Exports the chart as a binary Blob in PNG, SVG, or PDF format. |
| `fit(window: ChartViewportWindow \| readonly ChartViewportWindow[]): void` | **Deprecated.** Use 'setViewportWindow' instead. Fits the viewport window to a specified continuous range or category indices. |
| `fitViewport(target?: ChartNavigationAxisTarget): void` | Fits target axes (or all axes) to full canonical base domain. |
| `getViewport(): ChartViewportState \| null` | Returns the current active viewport window state, or null if chart is not Cartesian XY. |
| `invalidate(): void` | Schedules a new layout and paint, for changes the chart can't see, such as a mutated data array. |
| `pan(delta: { x: number; y: number }, target?: ChartNavigationAxisTarget): void` | Pans the viewport by pixel delta vector { x, y }. |
| `resetViewport(target?: ChartNavigationAxisTarget): void` | Resets the viewport window back to the default viewport (or base domain) for target axes. |
| `setViewport(viewport: ChartViewportState): void` | Sets the active viewport window state (full replacement). |
| `setViewportWindow(window: ChartViewportWindow \| readonly ChartViewportWindow[]): void` | Sets the viewport window for specific axis/axes (partial mutation). |
| `toggleSeriesVisibility(seriesId: string): void` | Toggles the visibility of a series. |
| `zoom(factor: number, anchor?: ChartPoint, target?: ChartNavigationAxisTarget): void` | Zooms the viewport by a scale factor around an optional pixel anchor point. |

### `TreemapSeriesComponent`

Renders hierarchical treemap visualizations using nested squarified, binary, dice, or slice-dice rectangles.

**Selector:** `mona-treemap-series`

#### Inputs

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `borderRadius` | `number \| undefined` | `undefined` | Corner radius in pixels applied to leaf node rectangles. |
| `categoryFormatter` | `ChartValueFormatter \| undefined` | `undefined` | Formatter callback for node labels. |
| `childrenField` | `ChartField` | `"children"` | Property key or accessor function extracting child nodes from a hierarchical data object. |
| `class` | `string` | `""` | Additional CSS classes applied to the series. |
| `color` | `string` | `""` | Fallback base fill color applied to series or root branches. |
| `colorField` | `ChartField \| undefined` | `undefined` | Accessor function or property key extracting an explicit fill color for a node. |
| `colors` | `readonly string[] \| undefined` | `undefined` | Explicit array of colors assigned to top-level branches and inherited down subtrees. |
| `data` | `readonly unknown[] \| unknown \| undefined` | `undefined` | Hierarchical root object or array of root nodes overriding chart-level data. |
| `field` | `ChartField` | `"value"` | Property key or accessor function extracting the numeric value for a leaf node. |
| `fillOpacity` | `number \| undefined` | `undefined` | Opacity of leaf node fills (0 to 1). |
| `hiddenNodeIds` (two-way) | `readonly string[]` | `[]` | The hidden top-level node IDs. Bind `[(hiddenNodeIds)]` for two-way binding; legend toggles write to it. |
| `keyField` | `ChartField \| undefined` | `undefined` | Property key or accessor extracting a stable datum identity across data updates. |
| `labelField` | `ChartField` | `"name"` | Property key or accessor extracting the display label for a node. |
| `labelFormatter` | `ChartValueFormatter \| undefined` | `undefined` | **Deprecated.** Use `categoryFormatter`, as on the other series. Formatter callback for node display labels. |
| `maxDepth` | `number \| undefined` | `undefined` | Maximum tree depth to layout and render. Normalized: finite <= 0 becomes 1, finite > 0 is floored, undefined/NaN/Infinity is unlimited. |
| `maxLabels` | `number` | `100` | Maximum number of DOM label candidates to render (prioritizing parent headers and largest leaf areas). |
| `minLabelHeight` | `number \| undefined` | `undefined` | Minimum pixel height required for a node to display a DOM label (defaults to 16 when showValues is false, 24 when true). |
| `minLabelWidth` | `number \| undefined` | `undefined` | Minimum pixel width required for a node to display a DOM label (defaults to 30). |
| `name` | `string` | `"Treemap"` | Series name used in tooltips and accessibility announcements. |
| `paddingInner` | `number` | `2` | Inner padding in pixels between sibling treemap rectangles. |
| `paddingOuter` | `number` | `4` | Outer padding in pixels around parent boundaries. |
| `parentFillOpacity` | `number \| undefined` | `undefined` | Fill opacity applied to non-leaf parent group background rectangles. |
| `parentHeaderHeight` | `number \| undefined` | `undefined` | Header height in pixels reserved for parent node header labels. |
| `showLabels` | `boolean` | `true` | Whether to display DOM labels for leaf and terminal nodes. |
| `showParentLabels` | `boolean` | `true` | Whether to reserve header space and display labels for parent grouping nodes. |
| `showValues` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether to display numeric values in default leaf labels. |
| `sort` | `ChartTreemapSort` | `"descending"` | Sort order for sibling nodes: "descending", "ascending", or "none". |
| `strokeColor` | `string` | `""` | Color of node boundary stroke borders. |
| `strokeWidth` | `number \| undefined` | `undefined` | Stroke width in pixels for node boundary borders. |
| `tile` | `ChartTreemapTile` | `"squarify"` | D3 treemap tiling algorithm: "squarify", "binary", "dice", "slice", or "slice-dice". |
| `valueFormatter` | `ChartValueFormatter \| undefined` | `undefined` | Formatter callback for numeric values in labels and tooltips. |
| `visible` (two-way) | `boolean` | `true` | Two-way bindable visibility of the series. |

#### Outputs

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hiddenNodeIdsChange` | `readonly string[]` | Emitted when `hiddenNodeIds` changes. |
| `nodeVisibilityChange` | `ChartTreemapNodeVisibilityEvent<unknown>` | Emits when an individual node or branch's visibility is toggled via the legend. |
| `visibleChange` | `boolean` | Emitted when `visible` changes. |

#### Methods

| Signature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `toggleNode(nodeId: string): boolean` | Shows or hides the node with this id, and returns whether it's now visible. |

### `RadialBarSeriesComponent`

Renders concentric circular progress rings with customizable bar gap, thickness, rounded corners, and background
tracks.

**Selector:** `mona-radial-bar-series`

#### Inputs

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `barGap` | `number` | `4` | Spacing in pixels between concentric radial rings. |
| `barThickness` | `number \| undefined` | `undefined` | Explicit radial thickness in pixels for each bar ring. |
| `categoryField` | `ChartField` | `"category"` | Property key or accessor extracting the category label for each radial ring. |
| `categoryFormatter` | `ChartValueFormatter \| undefined` | `undefined` | Formatter callback for ring category labels. |
| `class` | `string` | `""` | Additional CSS classes applied to the series. |
| `colorField` | `ChartField \| undefined` | `undefined` | Accessor function or property key extracting an explicit color for each radial ring. |
| `colors` | `readonly string[] \| undefined` | `undefined` | Explicit array of colors used to fill successive radial rings. |
| `cornerRadius` | `number \| undefined` | `undefined` | Corner radius in pixels applied to arc endpoints. |
| `data` | `readonly unknown[] \| undefined` | `undefined` | Series-specific dataset overriding root chart data. |
| `endAngle` | `number` | `360` | Ending angle in degrees (clockwise from 12 o'clock). |
| `field` | `ChartField` | `"value"` | Property key or accessor extracting the numeric value for each radial ring. |
| `fillMode` | `ChartRadialArcFillMode` | `"solid"` | Fill style applied to radial rings ("solid" or radial "gradient"). |
| `fillOpacity` | `number \| undefined` | `undefined` | Opacity of bar fills (between 0 and 1). |
| `hiddenItemIds` (two-way) | `readonly string[]` | `[]` | The hidden item IDs. Bind `[(hiddenItemIds)]` for two-way binding; legend toggles write to it. |
| `innerRadiusRatio` | `number` | `0.2` | Inner radius ratio relative to available plot bounds (0 to 1). |
| `keyField` | `ChartField \| undefined` | `undefined` | Property key or accessor extracting a stable datum identity across updates. |
| `max` | `number \| undefined` | `undefined` | Explicit maximum value for the radial bar progress scale. |
| `min` | `number \| undefined` | `undefined` | Explicit minimum value for the radial bar progress scale. |
| `name` | `string` | `"Radial Bar"` | Series name used in tooltips and accessibility announcements. |
| `outerRadiusRatio` | `number` | `0.9` | Outer radius ratio relative to available plot bounds (0.1 to 1). |
| `showTrack` | `boolean` | `true` | Whether to display background circular track rings. |
| `startAngle` | `number` | `0` | Starting angle in degrees (0 is 12 o'clock, clockwise). |
| `strokeColor` | `string` | `""` | Color of bar stroke boundary. |
| `strokeWidth` | `number \| undefined` | `undefined` | Stroke width in pixels for bar boundaries. |
| `trackColor` | `string` | `""` | Color of background track rings. |
| `trackOpacity` | `number \| undefined` | `undefined` | Opacity of background track rings. |
| `valueFormatter` | `ChartValueFormatter \| undefined` | `undefined` | Formatter callback for bar numeric values. |
| `visible` (two-way) | `boolean` | `true` | Two-way bindable visibility of the series. |

#### Outputs

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `datumVisibilityChange` | `ChartRadialDatumVisibilityEvent` | Emits when an individual ring's visibility is toggled via the legend. |
| `hiddenItemIdsChange` | `readonly string[]` | Emitted when `hiddenItemIds` changes. |
| `visibleChange` | `boolean` | Emitted when `visible` changes. |

#### Methods

| Signature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `toggleDatum(itemId: string): boolean` | Shows or hides the bar with this id, and returns whether it's now visible. |

### `FunnelSeriesComponent`

Renders conversion pipeline and sales funnel visualizations using connected trapezoidal stages. Supports vertical and
horizontal layouts, custom stage colors, inscribed DOM labels, widening stages (>100% conversion), and dynamic stage
visibility toggling.

**Selector:** `mona-funnel-series`

#### Inputs

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `categoryField` | `ChartField` | `"category"` | Property key or accessor extracting stage names. |
| `categoryFormatter` | `ChartValueFormatter \| undefined` | `undefined` | Optional custom formatter for category names. |
| `class` | `string` | `""` | CSS class name applied to the hidden series host element. |
| `color` | `string` | `""` | Uniform fill color for all funnel stages. |
| `colorField` | `ChartField \| undefined` | `undefined` | Property key extracting discrete colors per datum. |
| `colors` | `readonly string[] \| undefined` | `undefined` | Palette array of colors cycled across stages. |
| `data` | `readonly unknown[] \| undefined` | `undefined` | Array of stage data items overriding chart-level root data. |
| `field` | `ChartField` | `"value"` | Property key or accessor function extracting numeric values. |
| `fillOpacity` | `number \| undefined` | `undefined` | Fill opacity applied to stage trapezoids (0 to 1). |
| `gap` | `number` | `2` | Spacing in pixels between consecutive funnel stages. |
| `hiddenStageIds` (two-way) | `readonly string[]` | `[]` | The hidden stage IDs. Bind `[(hiddenStageIds)]` for two-way binding; legend toggles write to it. |
| `keyField` | `ChartField \| undefined` | `undefined` | Unique identifier key field for datums. |
| `labelContent` | `ChartFunnelLabelContent` | `"category-value"` | Content format for automatic stage labels. |
| `maxLabels` | `number` | `100` | Maximum number of visible stage labels rendered simultaneously. |
| `minLabelHeight` | `number \| undefined` | `undefined` | Minimum stage height required in vertical orientation to render label. |
| `minLabelWidth` | `number \| undefined` | `undefined` | Minimum stage width required in horizontal orientation to render label. |
| `name` | `string` | `"Funnel"` | Descriptive series name displayed in chart legend and tooltips. |
| `orientation` | `ChartFunnelOrientation` | `"vertical"` | Layout orientation of the funnel ('vertical' or 'horizontal'). |
| `showLabels` | `boolean` | `true` | Controls whether built-in stage text labels are rendered. |
| `strokeColor` | `string` | `""` | Stroke outline color for stage trapezoids. |
| `strokeWidth` | `number \| undefined` | `undefined` | Stroke width in pixels for stage trapezoids. |
| `valueFormatter` | `ChartValueFormatter \| undefined` | `undefined` | Custom formatter function for numeric values. |
| `visible` (two-way) | `boolean` | `true` | Controls overall visibility of the funnel series. |
| `widthRatio` | `number` | `0.9` | Maximum width ratio (0 to 1) for the funnel's widest stage relative to plot area. |

#### Outputs

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hiddenStageIdsChange` | `readonly string[]` | Emitted when `hiddenStageIds` changes. |
| `stageVisibilityChange` | `ChartFunnelStageVisibilityEvent<unknown>` | Emits when a stage's visibility is toggled via legend or API. |
| `visibleChange` | `boolean` | Emitted when `visible` changes. |

#### Methods

| Signature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `isDatumVisible(stageId: string): boolean` | Whether the stage with this id is visible. |
| `resetVisibility(): void` | Shows every stage again. |
| `setDatumVisibility(stageId: string, visible: boolean): void` | Shows or hides the stage with this id. |
| `toggleDatumVisibility(stageId: string): boolean` | Shows or hides the stage with this id, and returns whether it's now visible. |

### `DonutSeriesComponent`

Renders a full or partial donut. Use `ng-template[monaChartCenterTemplate]` for the center.

**Selector:** `mona-donut-series`

#### Inputs

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `categoryField` | `ChartField` | `"category"` | Property key or accessor extracting the category label for each slice. |
| `categoryFormatter` | `ChartValueFormatter \| undefined` | `undefined` | Formatter callback for slice category labels. |
| `class` | `string` | `""` | Additional CSS classes applied to the series. |
| `colorField` | `ChartField \| undefined` | `undefined` | Accessor function or property key extracting an explicit color for each slice. |
| `colors` | `readonly string[] \| undefined` | `undefined` | Explicit array of colors used to fill successive slices. |
| `cornerRadius` | `number \| undefined` | `undefined` | Corner radius in pixels applied to slice arc boundaries. |
| `data` | `readonly unknown[] \| undefined` | `undefined` | Series-specific dataset overriding root chart data. |
| `endAngle` | `number` | `360` | Ending angle in degrees (clockwise from 12 o'clock). |
| `field` | `ChartField` | `"value"` | Property key or accessor extracting the numeric slice value. |
| `fillMode` | `ChartPolarFillMode` | `"solid"` | Fill style applied to slices ("solid" or radial "gradient" from center to arc). |
| `fillOpacity` | `number \| undefined` | `undefined` | Opacity of slice fills (between 0 and 1). |
| `hiddenIndices` (two-way) | `readonly number[]` | `[]` | The hidden data indices. Bind `[(hiddenIndices)]` for two-way binding; legend toggles write to it. |
| `innerRadiusRatio` | `number` | `0.6` | Ratio of the inner hole radius relative to the outer radius (0 to 0.95). |
| `keyField` | `ChartField \| undefined` | `undefined` | Property key or accessor extracting a stable datum identity across updates. |
| `labelContent` | `ChartPolarLabelContent` | `"percentage"` | Content to display in default slice data labels. |
| `labelPosition` | `ChartPolarLabelPosition` | `"outside"` | Placement position for slice data labels ("outside" with leader lines or "inside" slice bounds). |
| `minLabelAngle` | `number` | `12` | Minimum slice arc angle in degrees required to render an inside data label. |
| `name` | `string` | `"Donut"` | Series name used in tooltips and accessibility announcements. |
| `outerRadiusRatio` | `number` | `0.9` | Outer radius ratio relative to available plot bounds (0.1 to 1). |
| `padAngle` | `number` | `0` | Angular padding in degrees between adjacent slices. |
| `showLabels` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether to display inside slice data labels. |
| `startAngle` | `number` | `0` | Starting angle in degrees (0 is 12 o'clock, clockwise). |
| `strokeColor` | `string` | `""` | Color of slice separator strokes. |
| `strokeWidth` | `number \| undefined` | `undefined` | Stroke width in pixels for slice separators. |
| `valueFormatter` | `ChartValueFormatter \| undefined` | `undefined` | Formatter callback for slice numeric values. |
| `visible` (two-way) | `boolean` | `true` | Two-way bindable visibility of the series. |

#### Outputs

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hiddenIndicesChange` | `readonly number[]` | Emitted when `hiddenIndices` changes. |
| `sliceVisibilityChange` | `ChartSliceVisibilityEvent` | Emits when an individual slice's visibility is toggled via the legend. |
| `visibleChange` | `boolean` | Emitted when `visible` changes. |

#### Methods

| Signature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `toggleSlice(dataIndex: number): boolean` | Shows or hides the slice at `dataIndex`, and returns whether it's now visible. |

### `OhlcSeriesComponent`

Renders traditional financial OHLC (Open-High-Low-Close) bar series with vertical high/low price spans, left-facing
open ticks, right-facing close ticks, and directional color coding.

**Selector:** `mona-ohlc-series`

#### Inputs

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `bodyWidth` | `number \| undefined` | `undefined` | Explicit total width in pixels for open/close tick arms. |
| `bodyWidthRatio` | `number` | `0.7` | Ratio of available category slot or mark spacing allocated to open/close tick arms (0.0 to 1.0). |
| `class` | `string` | `""` | Additional CSS classes applied to the series host element. |
| `closeField` (required) | `ChartField` | — | Property key or accessor extracting the closing price for each data item. |
| `color` | `string \| undefined` | `undefined` | Optional color override applied uniformly across all OHLC ticks and stems. |
| `data` | `readonly unknown[] \| undefined` | `undefined` | Series-specific dataset overriding the root chart data. |
| `dataLabels` | `ChartDataLabelsInput` | `false` | Data label display options or boolean flag enabling default labels. |
| `fallingColor` | `string` | `""` | Color for falling / bearish bars (close < open). |
| `fillOpacity` | `number \| undefined` | `undefined` | Fill and stroke opacity ratio (0 to 1). |
| `highField` (required) | `ChartField` | — | Property key or accessor extracting the highest price for each data item. |
| `keyField` | `ChartField \| undefined` | `undefined` | Property key or accessor extracting a stable datum identity across updates. |
| `lowField` (required) | `ChartField` | — | Property key or accessor extracting the lowest price for each data item. |
| `maxBodyWidth` | `number` | `32` | Maximum total tick width in pixels. |
| `name` | `string` | `"OHLC"` | Name of the series displayed in legends, tooltips, and live region announcements. |
| `neutralColor` | `string` | `""` | Color for neutral / flat bars (close === open). |
| `opacity` | `number \| undefined` | `undefined` | **Deprecated.** Use `fillOpacity`, as on the other series. Overall opacity multiplier applied to OHLC stems and tick arms. |
| `openField` (required) | `ChartField` | — | Property key or accessor extracting the opening price for each data item. |
| `risingColor` | `string` | `""` | Color for rising / bullish bars (close > open). |
| `seriesKey` | `string \| undefined` | `undefined` | Optional stable key identifying this series for mark identity and selection across updates. |
| `tickLength` | `number \| undefined` | `undefined` | Length in pixels for horizontal open and close tick arms. |
| `tickWidth` | `number \| undefined` | `undefined` | Backward-compatible alias for tickLength. |
| `valueFormatter` | `ChartAxisFormatter \| undefined` | `undefined` | Formatter callback transforming financial numeric values into custom display strings. |
| `visible` (two-way) | `boolean` | `true` | Whether the series is currently visible on the chart and in calculations. |
| `wickColor` | `string` | `""` | Explicit stroke color for the central vertical stem. |
| `wickWidth` | `number` | `1` | Pixel stroke width for OHLC stems and tick arms. |
| `xAxisId` | `string \| undefined` | `undefined` | Optional ID of the Cartesian X axis this series binds to. When omitted, the primary X axis is used. |
| `xField` | `ChartField \| undefined` | `undefined` | Property key or accessor extracting the X coordinate, overriding the root chart X field. |
| `yAxisId` | `string \| undefined` | `undefined` | Optional ID of the Cartesian Y axis this series binds to. When omitted, the primary Y axis is used. |

#### Outputs

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `visibleChange` | `boolean` | Emitted when `visible` changes. |

### `CandlestickSeriesComponent`

Renders financial Japanese candlestick series with central high/low wicks, rectangular open/close bodies,
rising/falling/neutral color coding, and solid or hollow rising bodies.

**Selector:** `mona-candlestick-series`

#### Inputs

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `bodyWidth` | `number \| undefined` | `undefined` | Explicit body width in pixels for candlestick candles. |
| `bodyWidthRatio` | `number` | `0.7` | Ratio of available category slot or mark spacing allocated to candle bodies (0.0 to 1.0). |
| `class` | `string` | `""` | Additional CSS classes applied to the series host element. |
| `closeField` (required) | `ChartField` | — | Property key or accessor extracting the closing price for each data item. |
| `color` | `string \| undefined` | `undefined` | Optional color override applied uniformly across all candle bodies. |
| `data` | `readonly unknown[] \| undefined` | `undefined` | Series-specific dataset overriding the root chart data. |
| `dataLabels` | `ChartDataLabelsInput` | `false` | Data label display options or boolean flag enabling default labels. |
| `fallingColor` | `string` | `""` | Color for falling / bearish candles (close < open). |
| `fillMode` | `ChartFinancialFillMode` | `"hollow"` | Visual fill mode for candle bodies: 'filled' (solid fill) or 'hollow' (rising hollow, falling filled). |
| `fillOpacity` | `number \| undefined` | `undefined` | Fill and stroke opacity ratio (0 to 1). |
| `highField` (required) | `ChartField` | — | Property key or accessor extracting the highest price for each data item. |
| `keyField` | `ChartField \| undefined` | `undefined` | Property key or accessor extracting a stable datum identity across updates. |
| `lowField` (required) | `ChartField` | — | Property key or accessor extracting the lowest price for each data item. |
| `maxBodyWidth` | `number` | `32` | Maximum candle body width in pixels. |
| `name` | `string` | `"Candlestick"` | Name of the series displayed in legends, tooltips, and live region announcements. |
| `neutralColor` | `string` | `""` | Color for neutral / flat candles (close === open). |
| `opacity` | `number \| undefined` | `undefined` | **Deprecated.** Use `fillOpacity`, as on the other series. Overall opacity multiplier applied to candle wicks and bodies. |
| `openField` (required) | `ChartField` | — | Property key or accessor extracting the opening price for each data item. |
| `risingColor` | `string` | `""` | Color for rising / bullish candles (close > open). |
| `seriesKey` | `string \| undefined` | `undefined` | Optional stable key identifying this series for mark identity and selection across updates. |
| `valueFormatter` | `ChartAxisFormatter \| undefined` | `undefined` | Formatter callback transforming financial numeric values into custom display strings. |
| `visible` (two-way) | `boolean` | `true` | Whether the series is currently visible on the chart and in calculations. |
| `wickColor` | `string` | `""` | Explicit stroke color for the upper and lower wicks. |
| `wickWidth` | `number` | `1` | Pixel stroke width for candle wicks. |
| `xAxisId` | `string \| undefined` | `undefined` | Optional ID of the Cartesian X axis this series binds to. When omitted, the primary X axis is used. |
| `xField` | `ChartField \| undefined` | `undefined` | Property key or accessor extracting the X coordinate, overriding the root chart X field. |
| `yAxisId` | `string \| undefined` | `undefined` | Optional ID of the Cartesian Y axis this series binds to. When omitted, the primary Y axis is used. |

#### Outputs

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `visibleChange` | `boolean` | Emitted when `visible` changes. |

Renders a continuous Cartesian area series supporting gradient fades, solid fills, cumulative stacking, and 100%

#### Inputs

| Name | Type | Default | Description |

### `ChartXAxisComponent`

Configures an X axis in Cartesian charts. Add more than one with distinct `axisId` values for multiple axes.

**Selector:** `mona-chart-x-axis`

#### Inputs

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `axisId` | `string \| undefined` | `undefined` | Optional semantic identifier for the X axis, referenced by series `xAxisId`. |
| `axisLine` | `boolean` | `true` | Whether the solid baseline axis border line is rendered. |
| `exponent` | `number` | `1` | Exponent for power scale (`type="pow"`). Must be a positive finite number. |
| `field` | `ChartField \| undefined` | `undefined` | Optional data field name for the X axis categories or values. |
| `formatter` | `ChartAxisFormatter \| undefined` | `undefined` | Custom formatter function for axis tick labels. |
| `gridLines` | `boolean \| undefined` | `undefined` | Whether vertical grid lines aligned with X-axis ticks are visible. Defaults to false in standard Cartesian and true for horizontal value axes. |
| `labelMaxWidth` | `number \| undefined` | `undefined` | Maximum unrotated width in pixels for tick labels before truncation. |
| `labelPadding` | `number \| undefined` | `undefined` | Spacing in pixels between the axis baseline / tick marks and tick labels. |
| `labelRotation` | `ChartAxisLabelRotation` | `0` | Explicit rotation angle in degrees for tick labels (-90 to 90), or 'auto' for responsive automatic angling. |
| `labels` | `boolean` | `true` | Whether the axis tick labels are rendered in the DOM. |
| `logBase` | `number` | `10` | Base logarithm for log scale (`type="log"`). Must be a positive finite number not equal to 1. |
| `max` | `number \| Date \| undefined` | `undefined` | Explicit upper bound for the axis range. |
| `min` | `number \| Date \| undefined` | `undefined` | Explicit lower bound for the axis range. |
| `nice` | `boolean` | `true` | Automatically extends the axis domain to round, pleasant values. |
| `position` | `ChartXAxisPosition` | `"bottom"` | Position of the X axis relative to the plot area. |
| `symlogConstant` | `number` | `1` | Constant for symlog scale (`type="symlog"`). Must be a positive finite number. |
| `tickCount` | `number \| undefined` | `undefined` | Suggested number of ticks to display along the axis (acts as preferred label count for category axes). |
| `tickMarks` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether tick mark lines extending outward from the baseline are drawn. |
| `tickSize` | `number \| undefined` | `undefined` | Length in pixels of outward tick mark lines. |
| `title` | `string` | `""` | Title text rendered alongside the axis. |
| `titlePadding` | `number \| undefined` | `undefined` | Spacing in pixels between the outward extent of tick labels and the axis title. |
| `type` | `ChartXAxisType` | `"auto"` | Scale type for the X axis (`"auto"`, `"category"`, `"linear"`, `"log"`, `"symlog"`, `"pow"`, `"sqrt"`, `"time"`, or `"utc"`). |
| `visible` | `boolean` | `true` | Whether the axis and its labels are visible. |

| `min` | `number \| undefined` | `undefined` | Explicit lower bound for the radial scale range. |
| `nice` | `boolean` | `true` | Automatically extends the radial domain to round, pleasant intervals. |
| `tickCount` | `number \| undefined` | `5` | Suggested number of concentric radial intervals. |
| `visible` | `boolean` | `true` | Whether the radial axis, grid rings, and tick labels are visible. |

### `ChartSelectionComponent`

Lets users select marks with the pointer and keyboard, and holds the selected mark IDs.

**Selector:** `mona-chart-selection`

#### Inputs

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `clearOnBackgroundClick` | `boolean` | `true` | Whether clicking plot background clears active selection. |
| `clickSelection` | `boolean` | `true` | Whether clicking marks selects/toggles them. |
| `color` | `string \| undefined` | `undefined` | Selection highlight stroke color override. |
| `defaultSelectedMarkIds` | `readonly string[]` | `[]` | Default selected mark IDs to seed initial uncontrolled selection. |
| `enabled` | `boolean` | `true` | Whether selection interaction is enabled. |
| `fillOpacity` | `number \| undefined` | `undefined` | Selection highlight fill opacity override. |
| `keyboardSelection` | `boolean` | `true` | Whether keyboard Enter / Space on focused marks selects/toggles them. |
| `mode` | `ChartSelectionMode` | `"single"` | Selection mode ('single' or 'multiple'). |
| `retainOnDataChange` | `boolean` | `true` | Whether selected mark IDs are retained across dataset changes. |
| `selectedMarkIds` | `readonly string[] \| undefined` | `undefined` | Controlled selected mark IDs. When defined, component acts as controlled state. Bind `[(selectedMarkIds)]` for two-way binding. |
| `strokeWidth` | `number \| undefined` | `undefined` | Selection highlight stroke width override. |

#### Outputs

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `selectedMarkIdsChange` | `readonly string[]` | Emits the proposed selected mark IDs. |
| `selectionChange` | `ChartSelectionChangeEvent<unknown>` | Emitted when mark selection is proposed or changed. |

### `ChartAngularAxisComponent`

Configures the angular dimension (spokes and continuous degrees) in Polar Axis charts.

**Selector:** `mona-chart-angular-axis`

#### Inputs

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `axisLine` | `boolean` | `true` | Whether the outer circular or polygonal baseline axis boundary line is rendered. |
| `class` | `string` | `""` | Additional CSS classes applied to the axis host element. |
| `formatter` | `ChartAxisFormatter \| undefined` | `undefined` | Custom formatter function for angular tick and spoke labels. |
| `gridLines` | `boolean` | `true` | Whether radial angular spokes connecting the pole to outer categories/ticks are visible. |
| `labelOffset` | `number` | `10` | Radial offset in pixels between the outer chart boundary and the angular labels. |
| `labels` | `boolean` | `true` | Whether angular category or degree labels are rendered. |
| `rotation` | `number` | `0` | Angular rotation offset in degrees applied clockwise to all spoke positions. |
| `tickCount` | `number \| undefined` | `undefined` | Suggested number of degree ticks for polar charts (defaults to 12). Radar tick count is derived from categories. |
| `visible` | `boolean` | `true` | Whether the angular axis, spokes, and labels are visible. |

### `ChartLegendComponent`

Adds a legend. Items toggle what they represent unless `interactive` is off.

**Selector:** `mona-chart-legend`

#### Inputs

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `class` | `string` | `""` | Additional CSS classes applied to the legend container. |
| `interactive` | `boolean` | `true` | Whether clicking or pressing Enter/Space on legend items toggles series visibility. |
| `mode` | `ChartLegendMode` | `"auto"` | Legend display mode: 'auto' (series items for standard charts, color scale for heatmap), 'series' (always series items), or 'color' (color gradient scale). |
| `position` | `ChartLegendPosition` | `"bottom"` | Layout position of the legend (`"top"`, `"bottom"`, `"start"`, `"end"`, `"left"`, or `"right"`). `start` and `end` follow the direction; `left` and `right` stay on that side. |

| `enabled` | `boolean` | `true` | Whether the tooltip is enabled and will appear during interaction. |
| `shared` | `boolean` | `false` | In shared mode, displays values for all visible series matching the active X coordinate. |

| `formattedFrom?` | `string \| undefined` | The start value of a range bar or range area mark, formatted for display. |
| `formattedHigh?` | `string \| undefined` | The high price of a candlestick or OHLC mark, formatted for display. |
| `formattedLow?` | `string \| undefined` | The low price of a candlestick or OHLC mark, formatted for display. |
| `formattedOpen?` | `string \| undefined` | The opening price of a candlestick or OHLC mark, formatted for display. |
| `formattedSize?` | `string \| undefined` | The size value of a bubble mark, formatted for display. |
| `formattedStackPercentage?` | `string \| undefined` | The mark's share of its stack total, formatted for display. The default label text for percent-stacked bar and area series. |
| `formattedStackTotal?` | `string \| undefined` | The total of the stack the mark belongs to, formatted for display. |
| `formattedTo?` | `string \| undefined` | The end value of a range bar or range area mark, formatted for display. |
| `formattedValue` | `string` | The value text the chart shows for the mark. For range marks it joins the start and end values; for horizontal bars it is the formatted x value. |
| `formattedX` | `string` | The x value of the mark, formatted for display. Empty when the mark has no x value. |
| `formattedY` | `string` | The y value of the mark, formatted for display. Empty when the mark has no y value. |
| `fromValue?` | `number \| undefined` | The start value of a range bar or range area mark. |
| `high?` | `number \| undefined` | The high price of a candlestick or OHLC mark. |
| `low?` | `number \| undefined` | The low price of a candlestick or OHLC mark. |
| `markId` | `string` | A stable identifier of the mark within the chart, the same one selection events report. |
| `open?` | `number \| undefined` | The opening price of a candlestick or OHLC mark. |
| `rawValue?` | `unknown` | The value read from the data item before stacking or other processing, when the series provides one. |
| `selected` | `boolean` | Persistent selection state for this mark. |
| `seriesId` | `string` | The identifier of the series the mark belongs to. |
| `seriesName` | `string` | The display name of the series the mark belongs to. |
| `seriesType` | `ChartSeriesType` | The type of the series the mark belongs to, such as `"bar"` or `"line"`. |
| `sizeValue?` | `number \| undefined` | The size value of a bubble mark. |
| `stackEnd?` | `number \| undefined` | The value where the mark ends on its stack. |
| `stackMode?` | `ChartStackMode \| undefined` | The stacking mode of the series, when the series is stacked. |
| `stackPercentage?` | `number \| undefined` | The mark's share of its stack total, as a percentage. |
| `stackStart?` | `number \| undefined` | The value where the mark starts on its stack. |
| `stackTotal?` | `number \| undefined` | The total of the stack the mark belongs to. |
| `toValue?` | `number \| undefined` | The end value of a range bar or range area mark. |
| `value?` | `unknown` | The value of the mark. A `[from, to]` pair for range marks, the aggregate value for hierarchical marks, and the y value otherwise. |
| `xValue?` | `unknown` | The x value of the mark. |
| `yValue?` | `unknown` | The y value of the mark. |

| `formattedOpen?` (read-only) | `string` | The opening price of a candlestick or OHLC mark, formatted for display. |
| `formattedSize?` (read-only) | `string` | The size value of a bubble mark, formatted for display. |
| `formattedStackPercentage?` (read-only) | `string` | The mark's share of its stack total, formatted for display. The default label text for percent-stacked bar and area series. |
| `formattedStackTotal?` (read-only) | `string` | The total of the stack the mark belongs to, formatted for display. |
| `formattedTo?` (read-only) | `string` | The end value of a range bar or range area mark, formatted for display. |
| `formattedValue` (read-only) | `string` | The value text the chart shows for the mark. For range marks it joins the start and end values; for horizontal bars it is the formatted x value. |
| `formattedX` (read-only) | `string` | The x value of the mark, formatted for display. Empty when the mark has no x value. |
| `formattedY` (read-only) | `string` | The y value of the mark, formatted for display. Empty when the mark has no y value. |
| `fromValue?` (read-only) | `number` | The start value of a range bar or range area mark. |
| `high?` (read-only) | `number` | The high price of a candlestick or OHLC mark. |
| `low?` (read-only) | `number` | The low price of a candlestick or OHLC mark. |
| `markId` (read-only) | `string` | A stable identifier of the mark within the chart, the same one selection events report. |
| `open?` (read-only) | `number` | The opening price of a candlestick or OHLC mark. |
| `rawValue?` (read-only) | `unknown` | The value read from the data item before stacking or other processing, when the series provides one. |
| `selected` (read-only) | `boolean` | Persistent selection state for this mark. |
| `seriesId` (read-only) | `string` | The identifier of the series the mark belongs to. |
| `seriesName` (read-only) | `string` | The display name of the series the mark belongs to. |
| `seriesType` (read-only) | `ChartSeriesType` | The type of the series the mark belongs to, such as `"bar"` or `"line"`. |
| `sizeValue?` (read-only) | `number` | The size value of a bubble mark. |
| `stackEnd?` (read-only) | `number` | The value where the mark ends on its stack. |
| `stackMode?` (read-only) | `ChartStackMode` | The stacking mode of the series, when the series is stacked. |
| `stackPercentage?` (read-only) | `number` | The mark's share of its stack total, as a percentage. |
| `stackStart?` (read-only) | `number` | The value where the mark starts on its stack. |
| `stackTotal?` (read-only) | `number` | The total of the stack the mark belongs to. |
| `toValue?` (read-only) | `number` | The end value of a range bar or range area mark. |
| `value?` (read-only) | `unknown` | The value of the mark. A `[from, to]` pair for range marks, the aggregate value for hierarchical marks, and the y value otherwise. |
| `xValue?` (read-only) | `unknown` | The x value of the mark. |
| `yValue?` (read-only) | `unknown` | The y value of the mark. |

#### `ChartDataLabelOptions`

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `allowOverlap?` | `boolean` | Whether labels may overlap other generic data labels. Default: false |
| `collisionPadding?` | `number` | Collision padding around the label bounds. Default: 2 |
| `color?` | `string` | Optional text color override. |
| `formatter?` | `ChartDataLabelFormatter` | Optional semantic formatter. Returning null/undefined/"" suppresses that label. |
| `maxLabels?` | `number` | Maximum accepted labels for this series. Default: 200 |
| `offset?` | `number` | Distance in CSS pixels between the mark anchor and label. Default: 6 |
| `overflow?` | `"clip" \| "hide"` | Plot-boundary behavior. Default: "hide" |
| `position?` | `ChartDataLabelPosition` | Placement strategy. Default: "auto" |

#### `ChartDownsamplingOptions`

| Name | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `algorithm?` (read-only) | `ChartDownsamplingAlgorithm` |
| `enabled?` (read-only) | `boolean` |
| `maxPoints?` (read-only) | `number` |
| `samplesPerPixel?` (read-only) | `number` |
| `threshold?` (read-only) | `number` |

#### `ChartExportBaseOptions`

Shared base options for all chart export formats.

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `background?` (read-only) | `ChartExportBackground` | Background color policy or explicit CSS color. Default: "auto". |
| `height?` (read-only) | `number` | Optional logical output height in CSS pixels. When omitted, the current chart aspect ratio or source height is preserved. |
| `presentation?` (read-only) | `ChartExportPresentationOptions` | Optional presentation options controlling selection, crosshair, and brush inclusion. |
| `signal?` (read-only) | `AbortSignal` | Optional AbortSignal for aborting the export operation. |
| `width?` (read-only) | `number` | Optional logical output width in CSS pixels. When omitted, the current chart width is preserved. |

#### `ChartExportPresentationOptions`

Options controlling which interactive/presentation elements are included in the export.

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `brush?` (read-only) | `boolean` | Whether to include active brush marquee overlay. Default: false. |
| `crosshair?` (read-only) | `boolean` | Whether to include active crosshair overlay and axis badges. Default: false. |
| `selection?` (read-only) | `boolean` | Whether to include persistent mark selection visuals. Default: true. |

#### `ChartExportResult`

Result of a chart export operation.

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `blob` (read-only) | `Blob` | The generated binary Blob containing the exported chart. |
| `format` (read-only) | `ChartExportFormat` | The export format that was produced. |
| `height` (read-only) | `number` | The logical output height in CSS pixels. |
| `mimeType` (read-only) | `string` | The MIME type of the exported blob (e.g. "image/png", "image/svg+xml", "application/pdf"). |
| `width` (read-only) | `number` | The logical output width in CSS pixels. |

| `page?` (read-only) | `ChartPdfPageOptions` | PDF page configuration. |

PDF page margins in PDF points (72 points = 1 inch).

| Name | Type |
| --- | --- |

| `right?` (read-only) | `number` |

Page layout options for PDF export.

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `margin?` (read-only) | `number \| ChartPdfMargins` | Page margins in PDF points. Default: 0 for "chart" page size, 24 for standard pages if not specified. |
| `orientation?` (read-only) | `"auto" \| "portrait" \| "landscape"` | Page orientation. Default: "auto" (derived from the chart aspect ratio). |
| `size?` (read-only) | `ChartPdfPageSize` | Target page size. Default: "chart". |

#### `ChartExportBackground`

Chart export background policy.
- "auto": Resolves the effective chart background color from the chart container/theme.
- "transparent": Creates a transparent background.
- CSS color string: Uses an explicit background color.

```typescript
type ChartExportBackground = "auto" | "transparent" | string;
```

#### `ChartPdfPageSize`

Standard or custom PDF page size.
- "chart": Custom page dimensions sized to exactly match the chart dimensions in PDF points.
- "a4": Standard ISO A4 page (595.28 x 841.89 pt).
- "letter": Standard North American Letter page (612 x 792 pt).
- Custom object: Explicit width and height in PDF points (72 points = 1 inch).

```typescript
type ChartPdfPageSize = | "chart" | "a4" | "letter" | { readonly height: number; readonly width: number; };
```

#### `ChartPdfRenderMode`

PDF generation rendering mode.
- "auto": Prefers vector output, falling back to embedded high-resolution raster image when vector fidelity cannot be guaranteed.
- "vector": Requires strict vector conversion; rejects if vector conversion is unsupported.
- "raster": Directly renders a rasterized chart image onto the PDF page.

```typescript
type ChartPdfRenderMode = "auto" | "vector" | "raster";
```

#### `MonaChartMessages`

From `@nanahoshi/mona-ui/i18n`.

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `announcementSeparator` (read-only) | `string` | Joins the parts of a screen reader announcement (", " in English). |
| `brushApplied` (read-only) | `(count: number) => string` | Announced when a keyboard brush is committed. |
| `brushCleared` (read-only) | `string` | Announced when a keyboard brush is canceled. |
| `brushRange` (read-only) | `(from: string, to: string) => string` | Announced while a keyboard brush is extended. |
| `category` (read-only) | `string` | The data table's first column header when the X axis has no title. |
| `categoryFallbackName` (read-only) | `(index: number) => string` | The name of a radar category without a value. |
| `categoryRange` (read-only) | `(from: string, to: string) => string` | The category range of a Cartesian chart, in its description. |
| `change` (read-only) | `string` | The tooltip label for a waterfall change step or a financial point's price change. |
| `changeValue` (read-only) | `(change: string) => string` | The price change in a financial announcement. |
| `chart` (read-only) | `string` | The chart's accessible name when it has neither an `ariaLabel` nor a title. |
| `chartLegend` (read-only) | `string` | The accessible name of the legend. |
| `chartRoleDescription` (read-only) | `string` | What screen readers call the chart (`aria-roledescription`). |
| `close` (read-only) | `string` | The tooltip label for a candlestick or OHLC point's closing price. |
| `closeAbbreviation` (read-only) | `string` | The short closing price label in a tooltip that lists several financial series ("C" in English). |
| `colorScale` (read-only) | `string` | The name of a heatmap color legend whose scale has no title, in its accessible name. |
| `conversion` (read-only) | `string` | The tooltip label for a funnel stage's conversion rate. |
| `conversionOfPrevious` (read-only) | `(rate: string) => string` | A funnel stage's conversion from the previous stage, in an announcement. |
| `dataTableTruncated` (read-only) | `(shown: number, total: number) => string` | Below the data table when it shows only the first rows. |
| `decrease` (read-only) | `string` | The waterfall legend's name for falling steps. |
| `decreaseAnnouncement` (read-only) | `(delta: string, from: string, to: string) => string` | Announced for a waterfall step that lowers the running total. |
| `divergingRangeDescription` (read-only) | `( title: string, minimum: string, midpoint: string, maximum: string ) => string` | The accessible name of a diverging heatmap color legend, with its minimum, midpoint and maximum. |
| `dropOff` (read-only) | `string` | The tooltip label for a funnel stage's drop-off from the previous stage. |
| `dropOffValue` (read-only) | `(value: string) => string` | A funnel stage's drop-off from the previous stage, in an announcement. |
| `falling` (read-only) | `string` | Names a falling candlestick or OHLC point, in the tooltip and in announcements. |
| `gaugeRange` (read-only) | `(minimum: string, maximum: string) => string` | A gauge's scale, in an announcement. |
| `high` (read-only) | `string` | The tooltip label for a candlestick or OHLC point's high price. |
| `highAbbreviation` (read-only) | `string` | The short high price label in a tooltip that lists several financial series ("H" in English). |
| `increase` (read-only) | `string` | The waterfall legend's name for rising steps. |
| `increaseAnnouncement` (read-only) | `(delta: string, from: string, to: string) => string` | Announced for a waterfall step that raises the running total. |
| `itemDeselected` (read-only) | `(item: string) => string` | Announced when the keyboard deselects a point. |
| `itemFallbackName` (read-only) | `(index: number) => string` | The name of a pie, donut, rose or radial bar item without a category. |
| `itemSelected` (read-only) | `(item: string) => string` | Announced when the keyboard selects a point. |
| `keyboardHelp` (read-only) | `string` | The keyboard instructions at the end of the chart's description. |
| `labeledValue` (read-only) | `(label: string, value: string) => string` | Pairs a label with a value in an announcement, such as a series name with the point's values. |
| `labelValueSeparator` (read-only) | `string` | Separates a label from its value in the tooltip (":" in English). |
| `low` (read-only) | `string` | The tooltip label for a candlestick or OHLC point's low price. |
| `lowAbbreviation` (read-only) | `string` | The short low price label in a tooltip that lists several financial series ("L" in English). |
| `noChange` (read-only) | `string` | The waterfall legend's name for unchanged steps. |
| `noChangeAnnouncement` (read-only) | `(value: string) => string` | Announced for a waterfall step that leaves the running total unchanged. |
| `noData` (read-only) | `string` | Shown and included in the chart's description when it has no data and no `noData` template. |
| `ohlcValues` (read-only) | `(open: string, high: string, low: string, close: string) => string` | A candlestick or OHLC point's prices, in an announcement. |
| `open` (read-only) | `string` | The tooltip label for a candlestick or OHLC point's opening price. |
| `openAbbreviation` (read-only) | `string` | The short opening price label in a tooltip that lists several financial series ("O" in English). |

| `rangeDescription` (read-only) | `( title: string, minimum: string, maximum: string ) => string` | Describes a range with its title, minimum and maximum: a range point in an announcement, or a heatmap color legend in its accessible name. |

| `rising` (read-only) | `string` | Names a rising candlestick or OHLC point, in the tooltip and in announcements. |
| `runningTotal` (read-only) | `string` | The tooltip label for a waterfall step's running total. |
| `seriesFallbackName` (read-only) | `(index: number) => string` | The name of a series without a name. |

| `seriesShown` (read-only) | `(series: string) => string` | Announced when a legend item shows a series or item. |
| `seriesSummary` (read-only) | `(count: number, names: string) => string` | The series of the chart, in its description. |
| `seriesValueRange` (read-only) | `(series: string, minimum: string, maximum: string) => string` | A series' lowest and highest value, in the chart's description. |
| `shareOfTotal` (read-only) | `(share: string) => string` | A treemap node's share of the whole, in an announcement. |
| `size` (read-only) | `string` | The tooltip label for a bubble's size. |
| `sizeValue` (read-only) | `(size: string) => string` | A bubble's size, in an announcement. |

| `stepPosition` (read-only) | `(position: number, total: number) => string` | A waterfall step's position among the steps, in an announcement. |
| `subtotal` (read-only) | `string` | The waterfall legend's name for subtotal steps. |
| `subtotalAnnouncement` (read-only) | `(value: string) => string` | Announced for a waterfall subtotal step. |
| `total` (read-only) | `string` | The waterfall legend's name for total steps. |
| `totalAnnouncement` (read-only) | `(value: string) => string` | Announced for a waterfall total step. |
| `treemapGroup` (read-only) | `(count: number) => string` | A treemap group, in an announcement. |
| `treemapLeaf` (read-only) | `string` | A treemap leaf, in an announcement. |
| `unchanged` (read-only) | `string` | Names a candlestick or OHLC point that closed at its opening price, in the tooltip and in announcements. |
| `value` (read-only) | `string` | The tooltip label for a point's value. |
| `valueRange` (read-only) | `(from: string, to: string) => string` | A range value in the tooltip ("10 – 20" in English). |
| `viewportResetToDefault` (read-only) | `string` | Announced when the keyboard resets the viewport to its configured default range. |
| `viewportResetToFull` (read-only) | `string` | Announced when the keyboard resets the viewport to the full data range, when no default range is configured. |
| `visualIndicatorClamped` (read-only) | `string` | Shown and announced when a gauge value lies outside the gauge's scale and its indicator stops at the edge. |
| `zoomedIn` (read-only) | `string` | Announced when the keyboard zooms the viewport in. |
| `zoomedOut` (read-only) | `string` | Announced when the keyboard zooms the viewport out. |
